description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - The Money Broking Regulations  No. 01.08.2018 effective  from 05.03.2018
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act. It establishes new regulatory requirements for money broking businesses, including authorization procedures, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements, operational guidelines, and compliance measures. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates a new regulatory framework for financial services.
